title: Owlshift ticket delivery
description:
The pull request a delivery opened and Owlshift's pushes to its branch, in
[`DELIVERY_FILE`] (OWL-209, architecture section 5, "Watch after
delivery"). `owlshift watch` follows it while it has a pull request and
has not `ended`.

base_at_push.description: The base branch's head at that push.

base_branch.description: The branch the pull request merges into.

ended.description: Why and when watch stopped following the pull request.

format.description: The format version of this document.

pull_request.description:
The pull request, once the forge showed the delivery's push as its
head; absent while the first push is under way.

pushed.description: The commit Owlshift last pushed, once the forge showed it as the head.

pushing.description: A push under way, until the forge shows it as the head.

rebased_onto.description:
The base commit the last rebase run whose push landed rebased onto
(OWL-210): a conflict read against it is a failed run of that
rebase, never a second rebase onto the same base head.

Ended.description: Why and when watch stopped following a pull request.

head.description: The head read, when someone else's push ended the following.

oneOf.description: A person pushed to its branch.

Pushing.description: A push of Owlshift's under way.

base.description:
The base branch's head read just before the push: `base_at_push`
once the push is adopted.

onto.description:
For a rebase run's push, the base commit the run rebased onto:
`rebased_onto` once the push lands or is adopted (OWL-210).
